newsitem.title: UK: Voice of Grand Prix, Murray Walker, goes to ITV.
newsitem.headline: Voice of Grand Prix, Murray Walker, goes to ITV.

text.p: The BBC's veteran Grand Prix commentator Murray Walker is to move to Independent Television (ITV) as lead commentator after ITV won the bidding for British rights to live coverage of Formula One racing.
ITV said Walker, whose excitable, high-pitched commentary has been the voice of televised Grand Prix in Britain for many years, had signed a two year contract.
"Motor racing is my passion and my life. Until very recently I saw that stopping, but thanks to ITV it is not stopping and I am carrying on, and that's why I am absolutely delighted," said Walker.
